title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**About Allica Bank**
 Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company \- and the fastest\-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
   

  

 Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities \- representing over a third of our economy \- yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
   

  

**Department Description**
 The Human Resource team is a small but growing team who are supporting Allica Bank and its employees to reach their goals. We’re a hands\-on team and there is great opportunity to develop your career whilst you help build one of the UK’s newest banks. Our employees are what helps us different from our competitors as part of the Human Resources team you will work on projects including engagement, recruitment, reward, L\&D and our ways of working with the aim of ensuring our employees are as effective as possible and Allica is truly great place to work.
   

  

**Role Description**
 The role of Senior Recruiter at Allica Bank will be responsible for leading recruitment campaigns across the business. The role will play a key part in ensuring that Allica Bank has the resources it requires to meet its growth agenda and ensuring that all candidates who are interacting with Allica Bank have a best\-in\-class candidate experience. The person will work with the Recruitment team, India head and Stakeholders to implement Allica’s recruitment strategy utilising methods to attract candidates, screen applicants, headhunt, arrange interviews and support candidates through to being onboarded as colleagues.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities** 
 
   

  

* Hire great people at pace 
* Build great relationships across the bank and support with the relevant business areas to assess their recruitment needs and manage campaigns to meet these needs
* Manage Allica Bank’s recruitment channels through agencies, direct and social media
* Manage Allica Banks End to End recruitment process  I
* nterview and screen prospective candidates to provide the business with high quality and diverse candidates 
* Role model and promote Allica culture and values 
* Develop and produce recruitment MI to support the refinement of Allica’s process and to drive improved outcomes for candidates and Allica


**Personal Attributes \& Experience** 
 
   

  

* Overall experience of 8\-10 years with Previous Banking/FS recruitment experience in managing the full recruitment cycle and the delivery of recruitment services, ideally from an in\-house environment or an RPO or recruitment agency 
* Proven experience of implementing recruitment strategies across organisations
* Experience in working with 3rd party suppliers such as media and agencies and Linkedin 
* Experience using Direct sourcing tools (such as LinkedIn, talent pooling, Executive Search and working with relevant job boards) 
* Commercial understanding of the business and how recruitment can support the requirements of stakeholders
* Strong organisational skills, to manage multiple recruitment campaigns, demands and tight deadlines 
* Ability to plan ahead to provide proactive Recruitment support to the business  Pragmatic, diplomatic, and a good team player
* Strong interpersonal skills, working effectively at all levels of the organisation


**Working at Allica Bank**
 At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
   

  

 Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
   

  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity \& Paternity leave


**Don’t tick every box?**
 Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
   

  

**Flexible working**
 We know the ‘9\-to\-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
   

  

**Diversity**
 We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

**What You'll Own** 




  




* The full range of searches, end to end, several at once. A C\-level hire and a junior specialist role in the same week, and both get done properly

* Real schedule flexibility across UAE, UK and US East Coast hours. Calls outside standard business hours are routine, not occasional

* An active, credible LinkedIn presence. You post, you engage, and people in your market know who you are. Passive profiles will not clear this bar



  





**What Stands Out** 




  




* Multi\-country or multi\-entity hiring
* You've built process, not only run someone else's
* You've been the only recruiter in the room and it was fine
* You've overseen or coached junior recruiters
* You've run A/B tests on titles, posts or channels and have the data to show for it
* AI\-assisted sourcing and outreach stack. Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, or equivalent. Name what you've built with it, not what you've heard of
* You've built a talent pipeline that produced a hire months after the first conversation
* You've worked somewhere with no employer brand and had to create the reason people said yes



  





**Benefits** 




  





**What you get** 




  





**Up to $80K/Annually** 
 , as an independent contractor, based on experience
 



  





**Direct access to founders.**

**A real AI stack, used daily.** 
 Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, LLM screening built into the workflow. You will use agents as part of the job, not as a side experiment, and you will have room to build your own
